text: @deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-nono 是为 DSH 接入 Nono 进程沙箱后端的 profile 插件。它注册 sandbox provider，将 DSH 文件策略编译为 Nono 能力配置，并通过已 vendored 的 wrapper 启动受约束的命令；首次需要时会探测执行通道并缓存结果。它提供只读和工作区写入策略对应的执行包装，并报告执行级别与拒绝特征。适合需要为 DSH 命令选择 Nono 后端的部署。当前仓库提供 Linux x64 GNU 绑定，macOS 需要相应绑定；不需要 API key 或外部账号。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-nono adds a Nono backend to DSH. It maps file policies to Nono capabilities, probes the channel, and wraps commands for read-only or workspace-write execution. Select it in a profile; the repository includes a Linux x64 GNU binding and needs no API key.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-nono 的功能「策略转能力配置」：将 DSH 沙箱策略的可写根路径规范化，并生成 Nono 使用的读写目录及文件配置。调用 confine 时处理策略并随包装参数返回。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-nono 的功能「通道探测与执行包装」：首次调用 confine 时探测 Nono 通道并缓存结果；探测通过后，返回由 SDK 构造的 wrapper 启动参数及执行状态信息。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-nono 的功能「后端配置」：sandbox-nono profile 行默认关闭，可在 profile overlay 中启用，并可设置通道探测超时。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-nono README · `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-nono`：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

The nono (Landlock/Seatbelt) backend as an installable DSH profile bundle. This standalone package contains the sandbox provider, its invariant companion, the bundle patch, and the vendored `@dsh-external/nono-ts` native executor carrier.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-nono README · Repository shape：```text
package.json              # standalone package and dsh.bundle manifest
cordis.patch.yml          # explicit sandbox-nono provider row
docs/                     # detailed bilingual Nono documentation
src/                      # provider and invariant companion

The bundle adds a distinct `sandbox-nono` row disabled by default. Enable it from a profile overlay when the deployment wants the Nono backend; the existing DSH `sandbox` row is not silently renamed or replaced.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-nono README · Repository shape：```yaml
- id: sandbox-nono
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-nono'
  disabled: false
  config:

The provider fails closed with `SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE` when the host has no vendored binding, the platform has no backend, or the functional channel probe does not prove enforcement. The SDK owns binding resolution, launch argv composition, wrapper failure classification, and channel qualification.

Detailed behavior and limitations: [`docs/nono.md`](docs/nono.md).

@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-nono README · Development：A full typecheck expects the DSH checkout beside this repository:

```text
../../deepseek-harness
```

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm run build

The `prepare` script builds directly from `src/`, so a package installation does not depend on the sibling checkout at runtime. The vendored carrier currently contains only the Linux x64 GNU binding; unsupported hosts intentionally fail closed.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-nono README · Model Experience：Indirectly, through `@deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-sandbox` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash`, which render enforcement and denial facts. The `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox` seam owns the `SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE` text.
